title: Atom record
description: One atom of the catalogue: a small capability a learner can hold, with its typed links. This is the shape the bootstrap emits and everything downstream reads.

status.description: lifecycle state; served atoms are active

statement.description: one sentence: what the learner can do

teachingUnit.description: the teaching text a tutor draws on

misconceptions.description: known wrong turns, each with a code the marker can emit

supportedActions.description: the actions a question may ask of this atom (apply, state, ...)

conceptualPrerequisites.description: atom ids that must be held before this one (typed edge: prereq)

derivableFrom.description: atom ids this one can be reconstructed from (typed edge: derivable)

perAction.description: per-action generation contract: radicals with banded values and costs
